procedure: On the already paid TEST order, call the actual payment-confirm endpoint with the same confirmation tuple. After the real duplicate HTTP 200, simulate loss of that response in the deployed frontend client; recheck the identical tuple against the actual endpoint.
limitations: Client response loss was simulated after an actual duplicate backend response. No actual network failure occurred during the original provider authorization.
No second provider charge or new order was initiated; original settled-order endpoint code returns before provider.confirm.
